title: Cassava Leaf Nucleic Acid Extraction
author: Devang Mehta
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iavcae6
materials: To each tube add ~200mg of leaf material
Continue with the following steps for RNA precipitation

steps.title: Prepare leaf sample
steps.instruction: Add a few glass beads to a 1.5 ml tube, freeze the tube in liquid nitrogen, and grind the leaf tissue with a homogeniser.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Make CTAB buffer containing 2 % CTAB, 2 % PVP‑40, 100 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 25 mM EDTA‑Na, 2 M NaCl, 0.5 g L⁻¹ spermidine; bring to final volume with DEPC‑treated water, add 2 % β‑mercaptoethanol (200 µl per 10 ml) just before use, incubate 1 h at room temperature, then autoclave.

steps.title: Add CTAB buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml CTAB buffer to the ground sample, mix thoroughly, and incubate 15 min at 50 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at full speed for 5 min, transfer 900 µl supernatant to a fresh 2 ml tube.

steps.title: First chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 900 µl chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), mix, and centrifuge at full speed for 10 min.

steps.title: Second chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer 800 µl supernatant to a new tube, add an equal volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), mix, and centrifuge at full speed for 10 min.

steps.title: Precipitate nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at –80 °C for 30 min (or at –20 °C overnight).

steps.title: Pellet nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at full speed for 30 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, wash pellet with 1 ml 80 % ethanol, centrifuge 5 min, and vacuum‑dry the pellet.

steps.title: Dissolve DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 100 µl DEPC‑treated water and keep on ice.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Aliquot required nucleic acid
steps.instruction: Pipette the desired amount of total nucleic acid from the solution.

steps.title: LiCl precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1/5 volume of 10 M LiCl (0.2 × total volume), mix, and incubate at –20 °C for at least 1 h.

steps.title: Pellet LiCl precipitate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at full speed at 4 °C for 30 min, discard supernatant, wash pellet with 80 % ethanol, centrifuge 5 min at 4000 rpm at 4 °C, and vacuum‑dry.

steps.title: Final resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 30–50 µl H₂O.

steps.title: Final ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer 650 µl supernatant to a fresh 1.5 ml tube, add 390 µl cold ethanol (0.6 × volume), mix, and proceed as needed.
